paper_title: Uncovering the Knowledge Boundaries and Mechanistic Knob of LLMs
frozen_backbone: previous cm checkpoints; not newly trained
split: identical canonical whole-timestamp60/20/20, same8192 training targets and<=100000 calibration rows, all original test rows
pseudo_target: training-only masked reconstruction MSE weighted by field width; low50%, high20%, middle omitted; thresholds from internal fitting rows
internal_validation: seeded80/20 split inside original training targets; no fraud labels; no calibration or test rows for ranking or candidate selection
hidden_states: clean-input projection,mean of native-view outputs per depth,fused state; 5x256 for original cm checkpoints

kan.univariate_edges: degree1 linear B-splines plus linear residual
kan.fallback: k10 if criterion not reached; explicitly report failure

primary_after: kan_fused =0.5*baseline+0.5*calibration upper-tail evidence of KAN logit
symbolic: ridge analytic surrogate of KAN logit with linear,square,tanh,log1p-square bases; report validationR2,not exact symbolic KAN equivalence
interventions: training-internal validation states only; normal,tangent,random and +/-tau; Eq10 pooled identity; probe-space diagnostic,not whole-network causal patching or deployed score correction
aggregation: 3 paired backbone seeds,mean and sampleSD,per-seed differences; no significance claim from3 seeds
test_label_policy: freeze all9 groups and score/threshold/model hashes before opening any new test label; historical test sets are retrospective and not new independent holdouts
paper_deviations: fraud labels not used; error proxy replaces answer correctness
native graph depth states replace transformer layers
internal training validation replaces test-based compactness selection
independent small spline KAN and analytic surrogate,not official paper implementation
probe-space sensitivity does not prove financial causal mechanism
control_rng: Selected top-k and random/uniform/linear controls use seed+1000+selected_k for initialization and identical minibatch RNG
reason_for_revision: Static implementation review found head randomness confounded component ablations;fixed before inspecting any new financial test metrics
